decision: Retain this exact material/diffuse as a concrete candidate surface reference, reject it for current artist usefulness, or stop at first unsupported/missing/unsafe link. Complete Mara rest form, ocular/auxiliary/53rig/expression duties stay separate and unresolved.

Identity-bound517member ZIP; exact1457-byte MHMAT entry matches recorded six fields/type/unencrypted and CRC. Preserve original unchanged text/filename readonly.

Exactly one top-level diffuseTexture directive with a literal PNG basename; other top-level texture maps, unknown/ambiguous/unsafe links stop. Legacy shader/parameter declarations are preserved as text, not resolved or executed.

One exact matching literal diffuse member, within remaining8MiB combined source cap, recorded ordinary metadata/unencrypted and actual CRC/SHA. PNG IHDR only, RGB/RGBA8 and at most4096x4096; no pixel decoder in worker. Preserve original name/data0444.
